mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_snapshot_daily (stat_date, sku_id, warehouse_id, qty_on_hand, qty_locked, qty_transit, qty_available) SELECT #{statDate} AS stat_date, src.sku_id AS sku_id, src.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, src.qty_on_hand AS qty_on_hand, src.qty_locked AS qty_locked, src.qty_transit AS qty_transit, src.qty_available AS qty_available FROM inventory src ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE qty_on_hand = src.qty_on_hand, qty_locked = src.qty_locked, qty_transit = src.qty_transit, qty_available = src.qty_available
